# Sabita Traders – authorised John Deere tractor dealer, Berhampur (Ganjam, Odisha)

> Sabita Traders, in Brahmapur (Berhampur), is the only authorised John Deere tractor dealer for Ganjam district, Odisha, India. Tractor sales, loans, old-tractor exchange, a John Deere service workshop and genuine parts are at one site.

## Key facts
- Address: NH5 Pathara Byepass Junction, Dura Bahadurpeta, Brahmapur, Odisha 760007, India
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 89085 89085 (second phone: +91 93375 00337)
- Email: 1sabitatraders@gmail.com
- Open: Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 8 PM (closed Sunday)
- Areas served: Berhampur, Aska, Bhanjanagar and the rest of Ganjam district
- Tractors (every model on our John Deere price list): 3036EN narrow orchard 4WD (35 HP), 5036D 2WD (36 HP), 5105 (40 HP, 2WD and 4WD), 5039D PowerPro 2WD (41 HP), 5042D PowerPro and GearPro 2WD (44 HP), 5045D PowerPro and GearPro (46 HP, 2WD and 4WD), 5050D PowerPro and GearPro (50 HP, 2WD and 4WD), 5310 PowerTech (57 HP, 2WD and 4WD), 5405 PowerTech (63 HP, 2WD and 4WD), 5075E PowerTech 4WD (76 HP)
- See it working: if a model is not at the showroom when you visit, we put you in touch with a farmer near you who owns one, so you can see it at work
- Finance partners (11): John Deere Financial India Pvt Ltd, State Bank of India, Axis Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank, IndusInd Bank, HDFC Bank, DCB Bank, Shriram Finance, Sundaram Finance, L&T Finance, Cholamandalam Finance
- Warranty: John Deere tractors carry a 5-year / 5,000-hour warranty, free and transferable, valid with scheduled service at an authorised workshop
- Indicative tractor prices, tractor only (lower figure is after the Odisha government subsidy, subject to eligibility and DBT approval: ₹1.2 lakh up to 48 HP, ₹1.5 lakh from 50 HP; upper figure is the MRP): 5105 ₹6.20 – 8.80 lakh (2WD ₹6.20 – 7.40, 4WD ₹7.60 – 8.80); 5039D PowerPro 2WD ₹6.40 – 7.60 lakh; 5045D PowerPro ₹7.40 – 10.00 lakh (2WD ₹7.40 – 8.60, 4WD ₹8.80 – 10.00); 5050D ₹7.80 – 11.00 lakh (2WD ₹7.80 – 9.30, 4WD ₹9.50 – 11.00); 3036EN ₹8.10 – 9.30 lakh; 5036D ₹5.50 – 6.70 lakh; 5042D PowerPro ₹6.80 – 8.00 lakh; 5310 PowerTech ₹9.30 – 13.70 lakh (2WD ₹9.30 – 10.80, 4WD ₹12.20 – 13.70); 5405 PowerTech ₹9.50 – 14.40 lakh (2WD ₹9.50 – 11.00, 4WD ₹12.90 – 14.40); 5075E PowerTech ₹16.10 – 17.60 lakh
- Implements, fitments and accessories cost extra. On-road price (with registration and insurance) is quoted on request on WhatsApp +91 89085 89085. EMI and exchange values from the website calculators are indicative
